_comment: Infrastructure map: exact tools bound to each node of the FLEET.toml stack specification. Machine half of the fleet spec; pairs with FLEET.toml (graph) and arch.mermaid (diagram). Numbers and node ids are copied from FLEET.toml, not re-derived.

meta.governance: No merge to main without green CI AND Mathew per-SHA sign-off (bindi#9). Nothing submitted to Boltz and nothing spent until the APPR human_gate approves.
meta.status: spec-level map; campaign one not yet run (submitted_to_date=false, spent_to_date_usd=0.00)

stack.note: only human-authored artifact; owner BIO Scientist
no prior art for a declarative in-graph approval+budget node; the novel part of the spec
halt at zero cost on deny

produces: 300 on-target binders vs the real epitope

stack.note: decoy refold: survivors x decoy panel, same HLA; prediction through the same API keeps the specificity screen inside the two-layer constraint

stack.known_weakness: four-tuple is a strict subset of Nextflow's hash (omits container image, environment, script text); widening to include ghcr image digest + code hash is the near-term fix (OD-8)

stack.runtime: pure CPU on box, zero GPU, zero rent
stack.implements: dunbracklab/IPSAE ipsae_d0res; bindi uses min(A->B, B->A) (reference uses aggregate max) for conservative weakest-direction screening
stack.inputs: PAE (pae.npz, per-token) + pLDDT and chains (label_asym_id, B_iso_or_equiv) from _predicted.cif
stack.validation: wiring-validated on real box fixtures 2026-10-20 (3/3 checks); end-to-end pending campaign one

stack.tool: diversity / novelty filter (cluster + cap per scaffold family)

stack.note: every row replayable from the manifest hash; hands off to BIO Physician and BIO Engineer

boltz_hosted_design_api.model_selector: NONE on design endpoint; versioning is by request shape

pricing.tier_note: 513-1024 residue tier is $0.10/design; cropping target below 512 total residues halves it

open_risks: boltzgen_backend_version (API does not report BoltzGen version; a pre-0.3.2 backend could silently drop negative design)
estimate-cost rejects the type-discriminated body (read-only pricing blocked)
account holds a LIVE key only, no test env

interface_descriptor_worker.guards: TokenAlignmentError on ligand/token vs polymer-residue mismatch; mismatched --chains fails loudly; no silent chain re-lettering

provenance.fleet_traces_format: merkle-jsonl (append-only JSONL, each line hash-links to the previous)
provenance.status: trace-record validation present; merkle hash-chaining is a project rule to wire before campaign one
provenance.known_weakness: four-tuple omits container image + environment + script text (OD-8)

containers.role: environment snapshot / backup of fleet environments
containers.auth: GITHUB_PAT (classic, repo + packages scope; secret, not stored here)
containers.planned_use: pin ghcr image digest into the content address to close the provenance gap

origin.wing_status: NOT present; mirror-or-create is Mathew's pending decision (GitHub is currently the single point of failure)

descriptors.roc_auc_note: AUCs transferred from Adaptyv Proteinbase (ODC-BY, 4273 PPIs, 17 targets) which contains NO pMHC complexes; every threshold is TRANSFERRED, not calibrated. Campaign one is itself the calibration experiment.

producer_map.min_ipsae: interface_descriptor_worker (ipsae.py, min of the two directions)
producer_map.complex_iplddt: box implementation pending (benchmark AUC only so far)
producer_map.pae_interaction: box implementation pending; derivable from pae.npz (benchmark AUC only so far)
producer_map.shape_complementarity: box implementation pending; needs a geometry/SASA tool not yet installed

excluded_tools.reason: the two-layer cut removes the orthogonal re-predictor; the published gates live on AF2 initial guess, which this stack does not contain. Boltz pae_interaction is not the same quantity. AF2 params are CC BY 4.0 if reinstated, but that puts a GPU layer back (open: thresholds question).
REJECTED 2026-10-20 (not deferred); bindi PR #13 closed. Modal stub code in src/bindi/structural_margin.py is inert. If self-hosting returns it is a fresh decision.

open_decisions_touching_infra: OD-8: widen content address to include ghcr image digest + code/script hash (adopt Workflow RO-Crate over CWL/Nextflow eventually)
Origin durability: mirror wing into Origin (recommended) vs create a deliberate Origin wing
thresholds: Boltz-native recalibration vs reinstating AF2 initial-guess (would re-add a GPU layer)
